about: McGinty's Best Thing Smoking BBQ is at 1221 S La Salle St in Navasota, run by Mark McGinty.

Mark built a reputation for his barbecue before he opened, and friends and the community pushed him to open a restaurant. KBTX profiled it in 2024 as a Black-owned barbecue spot becoming a staple in Grimes County, and The Navasota Examiner named it in its Best of Grimes County.
Customers have given it 4.8 stars across 198 Google reviews.
